rationale: X is at least at parity with the references: it traces the helper's two calling forms, URL and method inference, CSRF behavior, form/control option placement, block capture, legacy control configuration, and the requested edge cases. Consequential claims are either supported by the inspected source/tests or explicitly marked untested/open, especially nil destinations, GET with an explicit token, and unsafe labels. The brief remains behavior-focused rather than prescribing an implementation and gives useful compatibility risks and external success criteria.
